languageModelTools.name: emit-code-from-typespec
languageModelTools.userDescription: This tool is designed to emit or generate various types of code artifacts for a specified target language. e.g. .NET azure sdk
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates various types of code artifacts from a TypeSpec file for a specified target language. This tool supports generating client libraries, server stubs, OpenAPI specifications, and AI-related documentation. Supported target languages include .NET, Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, and others. It is designed to streamline multi-language code generation workflows from a unified TypeSpec definition.
